notes.title: Anniversary Update! Available now!
notes.notes:
Hello from Stardust Collective!

It has been 1 year since the launch of Ziggy's Cosmic Adventures! We wanted to give a special thanks to all of you for following us this whole time, it means a lot to us.

We've just released our Anniversary Update (1.2.0), here's a quick overview of some of the big changes:

- Balance changes across all difficulty modes, making the game a much better experience for all difficulty modes
- Added a new hint system for unlocking alternate routes, viewable in the Pause Menu
- Full passes over all levels to iron out bugs, removing potential soft-locks, improved enemy AI, and many more tweaks, changes, and bug fixes
- Added many new dialogue lines for many characters to better react to different situations, giving way more useful tips and hints throughout gameplay
- All characters now express a wide range of emotions and personality in response to the story and dialog on the tablet screen via all new animations

And much more! View the full changelogs here: https://www.stardustcollective.dev/patch-notes.html

Dive back in, and good luck on your next adventures through the cosmos!

notes.title: Quick bugfix

notes.title: Winter patch!
notes.notes:
A small winter theming patch with some bug fixes!


 Bombs are now presents
 Ziggy (and some other characters) put on their christmas clothes
 PAL hung up some christmas lights in the cockpit
 Escaping Okamahina should be more consistent
 Fix some performance issues
 Fix some other small bugs


We're still working on our next update which will fix more bugs and add some more difficulty options!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey Cosmonauts, this is a small patch to fix the biggest bugs that we have encountered so far. As always please do contact directly or through our social channels for any issues that you are having!

PATCH NOTES


 Fix Steam achievements!
 Enable reflections on objects outside the ship
 Remove developer menu (we didn't mean to commit this, but is this something people still want?)
 Make more dialogue in the tutorial skippable, allowing the tutorial to take a lot less time
 Fix height callibration to have the correct height more consistently
 Fix getting stuck in 5a (Okamahina) core. This was an inconsistent issue, so we haven't confirmed that it is entirely fixed. If you still get stuck to report it.
 Fix invisible enemies sometimes appearing. This was an inconsistent issue, and so we haven't confirmed that it is entirely fixed. If you still see invisible enemies, do report it to us.
 Fix battle cruiser in 3a (Yedem) sometimes spawning in the incorrect location
 Fix some unlikely crashes, including mailbox related crash.
 Fixed checkpoints not working in 2a (Kamney Belt)


- The Stardust Team
